unit_of_analysis: GEO expression-matrix columns; biological independence is unverified; exact tests condition on exchangeability

mapping_assumptions.cell_prefix_crosswalk: A=AsPC-1, P=PANC-1, C=CFPAC-1, S9=SW1990, inferred from abbreviations; no explicit matrix crosswalk
mapping_assumptions.treatment_suffix: NT=vehicle; M=the applicable inhibitor, interpreted against GEO sample metadata
mapping_assumptions.pdx_column_crosswalk: p1-p3 vehicle and p4-p6 MRTX1133+Olaparib inferred by positional order of GEO sample records
mapping_assumptions.confirmatory_status: All effects and permutations are conditional until sample-to-column mapping and replicate independence are confirmed

replicate_design_discrepancy: GEO provides three columns per condition; article Methods say cells were cultured in duplicate. Replicate independence/count requires clarification.

groups.G12D_cell_lines: three provisional cell-line mappings, vehicle vs MRTX1133, 3 GEO columns per group per line, 24 h; biological replicate independence unverified
groups.G12V_line: provisional CFPAC-1 mapping; vehicle vs BI-2865, 3 GEO columns per group; separate exploratory stratum
groups.PDX: 3 vehicle vs 3 MRTX1133+olaparib endpoint columns under provisional positional mapping; no single-agent arms in this expression matrix

statistics.effect: Cohen d, equal-variance pooled SD, on log2(FPKM+1)
statistics.G12D_cell_lines: exact permutations of 3/6 labels within each provisional cell-line mapping, 8000 combinations; conditional on independence
statistics.two_group_small_strata: exact 3/6 label permutations, 20 combinations; minimum two-sided p may be 0.10
statistics.multiple_testing: BH across estimable tests from 9 predeclared control x gene comparisons; unavailable markers remain unestimated

scope: does not run the universal 29-estimator core/TLog; expression reproduction only; no clinical/cure claim
